subject: Re: StackLift + Redwood co-sell demo — runway and timezone split
messages:
From: Amit Patel <amit@stacklift.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Morgan <sarah.morgan@aws-partner.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: StackLift + Redwood: co-sell demo runway

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the quick chat at AWS Partner Connect. StackLift's GTM lead asked us to get a joint demo scheduled with Redwood and the AWS SI that owns the account so we can show the integration and a short partner value narrative for the marketplace listing.

High-level asks:
- 60m session (40m technical demo + 20m exec Q&A)
- Short runbook we can share with the SI and AWS PM
- Recording enabled for internal replay

Our team is PST-based (SF). We can do the following windows next week:
- Tue 2027-09-07 09:00–10:00 PT
- Wed 2027-09-08 14:00–15:00 PT

Looping in Sarah as the AWS partner manager — Sarah, can you confirm SI availability for those windows or suggest alternates?

Thanks,
Amit
Amit Patel
Partnerships, StackLift
amit@stacklift.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Patel <amit@stacklift.ai>
Cc: Sarah Morgan <sarah.morgan@aws-partner.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 5 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StackLift + Redwood: co-sell demo runway

Hi Amit —

Great to connect — appreciate the clear asks. A couple of quick notes from Redwood:
- We prefer splitting as you suggested (45m tech / 15m exec) to keep momentum.
- Can you confirm whether the SI needs SSH access to a test VM or just API keys?
- We’ll provide a one-page runbook and a calendar invite.

Proposed slots (we'll add Karthik (SE lead) and Vanessa (partnerships) to the invite):
- Tue 2027-09-07 09:30–10:30 PT (we can do a 45/15 split inside this window)
- Wed 2027-09-08 14:00–15:00 PT

If those don't work for the SI, we can also offer Thu 2027-09-09 08:00–09:00 PT as a fallback.

Karthik / Vanessa — could you confirm SE availability and whether we should prepare a short smoke-check 30 minutes before the main session? Diego, can you standby for the tech run-through?

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0123
From: Sarah Morgan <sarah.morgan@aws-partner.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Amit Patel <amit@stacklift.ai>
Date: Sun, 5 Sep 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StackLift + Redwood: co-sell demo runway

Thanks both — quick constraints from the SI side: the SI PM covering EMEA has a late-afternoon cadence and cannot do mornings US time that week. The SI's US lead is flexible but will be in customer work Tue morning.

Proposed compromise:
- Wed 2027-09-08 15:30–16:30 PT (allows EMEA PM to join late afternoon in BST)
- Thu 2027-09-09 08:00–09:00 PT (SI US lead can make this)

On the runbook and test creds: the SI prefers not to receive long PDFs for initial ops — a one-page checklist + a short set of API keys (scoped to test project) is ideal. Also please include who will run the provisioning steps during the demo (StackLift or Redwood).

Sarah
Sarah Morgan
AWS Partner Manager — Strategic SI Programs
sarah.morgan@aws-partner.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Patel <amit@stacklift.ai>, Sarah Morgan <sarah.morgan@aws-partner.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StackLift + Redwood: co-sell demo runway (runbook + invites)

Thanks — we chatted with the SE team and can accommodate the following final plan:

Final: Thu 2027-09-09 08:00–09:00 PT (60m) — split 45m tech / 15m exec.
- 07:30 PT smoke check (30m) for SEs only — Diego and I will run this.
- We'll supply scoped API keys (test-project-readonly) and a one-page ops checklist.

Attachments included: co-sell_runbook_v2.pdf (one-page checklist + quick runbook), runbook-playlist.xlsx (step checklist), redwood-demo.ics (calendar invite with conferencing).

Notes:
- Provisioning: StackLift will trigger initial provisioning (they have the sandbox subscription). Redwood will run the inference demo and validate integration endpoints.
- Recording: we will enable recording in the meeting; if any participant objects we'll disable post-notice.

Amit — please confirm that StackLift will create the sandbox creds and email them to diego_fernandez@redwood.ai before 07:00 PT on Thu.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0166
From: Amit Patel <amit@stacklift.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Sarah Morgan <sarah.morgan@aws-partner.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StackLift + Redwood: co-sell demo runway (runbook + invites)

Perfect — Thu 2027-09-09 08:00–09:00 PT works for us.

A few quick asks:
- We'll email scoped sandbox keys to diego_fernandez@redwood.ai by Wed 2027-09-08 16:00 PT.
- Please send the calendar invite and the one-page runbook to the SI lead so they can confirm.
- Recording OK. StackLift also requests a 15-min prep call 30 minutes before the smoke-check (i.e., 06:45 PT) to run through slides and roles — can Diego join then?

Thanks — excited to get this on the calendar.
Amit
